title: Foundation model embeddings capture pre-diagnostic changes on screening mammograms
abstract: arXiv:2609.26605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation model embeddings of screening mammograms may encode pre-diagnostic tissue change without task-specific adaptation. We tested whether embeddings move faster along a data-derived "cancer direction" in women later biopsied for cancer than in matched screen-negative controls, and whether this depends on pretraining domain. We studied 1,773 biopsied women (785 malignant, 988 biopsy-negative) and 1,773 matched controls, each with at least two annual screening exams before their index exam. An identical pipeline was applied to four 2D models: Mammo-CLIP (MC, out-of-distribution mammography), HOPPR (in-distribution mammography), MedImageInsight (MII, general medical imaging), and BiomedCLIP (biomedical vision-language pretraining on literature figures). translated_title: 基础模型嵌入能够捕捉筛查乳腺X线照片上的诊断前变化
translated_abstract: 筛查乳腺X线照片的基础模型嵌入可能无需任务特定适配即可编码诊断前的组织变化。我们测试了在后来因癌症接受活检的女性中，嵌入是否比匹配的筛查阴性对照者更快地沿着数据衍生的“癌症方向”移动，以及这是否取决于预训练领域。我们研究了1,773名接受活检的女性（785例恶性，988例活检阴性）和1,773名匹配的对照者，每人在索引检查前至少有两次年度筛查检查。我们对四个2D模型应用了相同的流程：Mammo-CLIP（MC，分布外的乳腺X线摄影）、HOPPR（分布内的乳腺X线摄影）、MedImageInsight（MII，通用医学影像）和BiomedCLIP（基于文献图像的生物医学视觉-语言预训练）。乳腺水平的嵌入量化了沿癌症方向的纵向移动。我们使用患者间设计并结合补充的混合效应分
tldr: 该研究发现基础模型嵌入无需任务特定适配即可捕捉筛查乳腺X线照片上的诊断前组织变化，沿着数据衍生的“癌症方向”的移动速度在后来确诊癌症的女性中更快，且这一效应依赖于模型的预训练领域。
en_tdlr: Foundation model embeddings can capture pre-diagnostic tissue changes on screening mammograms without task-specific adaptation, with embeddings moving faster along a data-derived "cancer direction" in women later biopsied for cancer, depending on the pretraining domain.
